selection: Earliest metadata-compatible unseen LINK session after Feb04, and earliest unseen FALCON X session after Dec07; chosen before model fitting or prediction error inspection.
models: Reuse existing algorithms and source-only tuning. SSL reference setting only, original three seeds; no new architectures or target-driven choices.
calibration: First75 original target trials, remaining target trials evaluation. Same prior label budgets; target calibration mean added to longitudinal controls.
hypotheses: Frozen source transfer need not outperform source means.
Target neural calibration may improve over label-matched calibration means.
Pretrained features need not improve over matched random/supervised controls.
endpoints: Equal-trial MSE in separately named native target units; paired contrasts and five-trial block sensitivity. No practical-superiority threshold or multiplicity-corrected inference.
limitations: FALCON is author-preprocessed exploratory EMG; cannot certify train-only original target processing.
One new session per existing animal adds session replication, not a new biological subject.
All resulting evaluation sets become inspected; no later model tuning against them.
